# PR 260 - independent terminal F1-F3 assessment

Fresh, independent, owner-assigned Sol/Ultra one-task assessment at the exact
head above. I did not author, repair, or previously review this PR. Trusted
policy/persona pin: `dfe734d3afc1220e3a823a206163ed338a511c6c` (read via
`git show`, not from the candidate). This disposes the three findings of review
5236094789; it is **not** a sixth full review of the PR.

## Findings

<!-- findings:begin -->
- [x] F1 (code; changes) `results/telemetry/model-comparison/astra-effort-integration-20260906.md:3` - Resolved at `d2f00e69`: the note dates and supersedes the old Max/XHigh selection, eight-to-eleven worker allocation, and posted-#26 owner hold, while retaining their historical observation and pointing to the governing `local/protocols/issues-prs.md` section 6. The README link is also identified as historical.
- [x] F2 (code; changes) `results/telemetry/events.md:5043` - Resolved at `d2f00e69`: the amendment now cites the committed owner-message record as authority and retains the temporary path and its at-inspection SHA-256 only as secondary provenance. The committed message supports the precise 2026-09-06T05:05Z access-only grant, B8 attempts 11/12 at at most 2700 seconds each, 19931 prior seconds, and the 25331-second cumulative ceiling; this is not a fresh grant.
- [x] F3 (code; minor) `results/telemetry/events.md:7898` - Resolved by the alternative qualification at `d2f00e69`, not by restoring the line in place. The two former verbatim claims now say line-level reconstruction; the dated correction at lines 9032-9049 quotes the missing Handover continuation and distinguishes the older truncated stub. Direct comparison with `428b11cd` confirms both locations. No historical event fact was discarded by this repair.
<!-- findings:end -->

## Review

Five earlier marked, fully reviewed heads remain on record:
`df9b555ebe88e0b29787aaad12241371436a88f5`,
`ecba3e73c4e572d53967c058db9688829ff8b80f`,
`428b11cd71e4cd2a852094b5bfefd41f316393c2`,
`a56b0e950a5f55d1376376585587a21d34e402ec`, and
`97eece72c5a76f66cdd039abfee72368d2e8c831`. I read their review
ledgers in the admission; the first shim finding was resolved in the earlier
rounds. This assessment preserves those decisions and their costs.

I compared the bounded repair commit with its parent `581994726271bdd7bc30bbd4fe32a1dc5d13f926`:
only `events.md`, the model-comparison README, and the historical integration
note change; `git diff --check` passes. The committed authority message is
identical at the trusted policy pin and this head. Comparing the actual
operator-takeover paragraph at `428b11cd:results/telemetry/events.md:4375`
with this head at line 7940 shows the missing line in the Handover bullet and
the preserved older truncated stub, as the new correction reports. The repair
edits explanatory sentences in prior events and appends a correction, but
preserves the historical observations, original hashes, and cumulative limits.

The consulted admission reports exact-head `local-ci/summary=success` with all
eight component contexts green. This was not a new CI query or run. No Lean,
blueprint, protocol, or runtime source changed in the bounded repair, so the
prose lane is n/a. No full CI, build, tests, fresh provider verification,
review script, descendant, publication, or GitHub action was performed. The
assigned worktree remained clean and at the pinned head throughout. MAIN owns
publication and any gate or merge decision.

VERDICT: APPROVED
